newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Time Telecom IPO to offer 470 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Time Telecom IPO to offer 470 mln shares.

text.p: Time Engineering Bhd said on Tuesday that a proposed initial public offering of its unit Time Telecommunications Holdings Bhd will consist of 470 million new shares at 1.25 ringgit a share.
In a statement, Time Engineering also said it will have a shareholding of about 70 percent of Time Telecommunications upon its listing.
Time Engineering had held a news conference on Monday to discuss the proposed offering. But it did not provide details on the IPO at the meeting.

In the statement, Time Engineering said the proposed public issue of 470 million shares would be made up of 220 million shares to approved Bumiputra (ethnic Malay) investors and the remaining 250 million to the Malaysian public and eligible employees of certain Time Group companies.
It also proposed a public issue of 450 million nominal value of 25 percent irredeemable convertible loan stocks at 2.50 ringgit to the Malaysian public.
On the stock issue, it is proposing a restricted issue of up to 10 million new Time Telecommunications shares at 1.25 ringgit a share to shareholders of Time on a non-redeemable basis.

It is also proposing a restricted issue of up to 150 million nominal value of the loan stocks at 2.50 ringgit to subscribers of its Time Telecommunications and Sapura Digital Sdn Bhd phone services "at a cut-off date to be determined later".
It said that using the discounted cashflow method of valuation and on the basis of certain assumptions, the rate of return on the Time Telecommunications shares at 1.25 ringgit is about 17 percent.
